# gandi_domain (Data Source)

Look up an existing Gandi domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gandi_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}

output "current_nameservers" {
  value = data.gandi_domain.example.nameservers
}

output "expires_at" {
  value = data.gandi_domain.example.registry_ends_at
}

# Whether the registry accepts DNSSEC keys (gandi_dnssec_key) for this domain.
output "dnssec_available" {
  value = data.gandi_domain.example.dnssec_available
}

# Automatic renewal setting and lifecycle dates, e.g. for a check block.
# autorenew is null when Gandi does not report it, hence try().
output "autorenew_enabled" {
  value = try(data.gandi_domain.example.autorenew.enabled, null)
}

output "deletes_at" {
  value = data.gandi_domain.example.deletes_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `autorenew` (Attributes) Automatic renewal setting (see `gandi_domain_autorenew`). Null if Gandi does not report it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autorenew))
- `created_at` (String)
- `deletes_at` (String) When the domain is deleted if not renewed. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `dnssec_available` (Boolean) Whether the registry accepts DNSSEC keys for this domain (see `gandi_dnssec_key`). Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `hold_begins_at` (String) When the domain enters hold after expiring. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `hold_ends_at` (String) End of the hold period. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String)
- `pending_delete_ends_at` (String) End of the pending-delete period. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `registry_ends_at` (String) Expiry date at the registry.
- `renew_begins_at` (String) Start of the renewal period. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `restore_ends_at` (String) End of the restore (redemption) period. Null if Gandi does not report it.
- `status` (List of String)
- `tld` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--autorenew"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autorenew`

Read-Only:

- `dates` (List of String) Scheduled automatic renewal attempts.
- `duration` (Number) Years added at each automatic renewal.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic renewal is on.
- `org_id` (String) UUID of the organization billed for automatic renewals.
